extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.quote: On the guidance, we expect high single -digit consolidated top line growth for FY27 based on our current understanding of the regulatory and macro environment.
items.why: First-half sales grew 11%, ahead of the guidance, with half the year still to go.
items.actual_quote: For the first half, sales were at INR3,12,836 million, registering a growth of 11% over the first half last year.

items.quote: We expect our FY27 R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of the sales for the next year.
items.why: R&D ran at 5.4% of sales in Q1 and 4.8% in Q2; management says the second half will catch up some of it.
items.actual_quote: Consolidated investments towards R&D for Q2 '27 stands at INR7,784 million or 4.8% of sales.

items.quote: We expect the effective tax rate to be in the range of 25%.
items.why: The tax rate was 27.8% in Q1 and 28.3% in Q2, well above the guided level.
items.actual_quote: Effective tax rate for the quarter was 28.3% versus 24.7% in Q2 FY26.
